name: nocturne
title_zh: 周末美股代币报价，先查它到底能不能信
tagline_zh: 周六凌晨看到 rNVDA 跳了 4%，别急着下单——先跑一遍它，分清哪些是真实成交、哪些只是做市商在撑盘。
tagline_en: rNVDA jumps 4% on a Saturday night. Before you buy, check whether that move is real trading or just a market.
desc_en: Check whether a tokenized US stock (rToken) price on Bitget is trustworthy right now. Use when the US market is closed - weekends, overnight, pre-market - and someone asks what an rToken is really worth, how much they can actually trade, whether a weekend move is real, or what happens to their order on Monday. Covers 87 weekend-tradeable rTokens including rNVDA, rAAPL, rTSLA, rMSFT, rMU, rCRCL, rM
why_zh: 它不猜方向，只做一件事：把 Bitget 上 rToken 的报价拆成可交易深度。
why_en: It doesn't predict direction. It splits an rToken quote into tradeable depth, real fill evidence, and Monday settlement risk.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Bitget 上那 87 个周末可交易的 rToken，别的所、别的代币它不认识。
limit_en: Only the 87 weekend-tradeable rTokens on Bitget — other exchanges or tokens are out of scope. It rates trustworthiness, not buy/sell advice, and.
title_en: Weekend rToken quotes: is that price real?
